integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Photorealistic live-action film footage of real actors in an ancient Chinese (Song-dynasty) period drama, with the look of a feature film. The location shown in <Picture 1> is the set, keeping its layout and props. Initial composition: Before the old plank barn at the edge of the Liuxi fields in the early morning of the next day: the place exactly as in the picture: the low old barn of grey weathered planks at the right under its pitched plank roof, its two plank door leaves swung back flat against its front on both sides of the dark doorway, a broad strip of trampled sun-warmed earth before it running out of the frame at the lower right edge, the path from the village, the flooded field of young green rice seedlings across the left half of the frame, small village houses and low blue hills far away, one big tree behind the barn; low warm golden morning sunlight from the right, long shadows across the trampled earth, a clear pale blue sky: medium-wide shot from behind six people of the village standing in a loose row across the frame on the trampled earth with their backs to the camera, facing the barn, framed from the waist up: an old man with a white topknot in a faded grey long robe, a thin middle-aged man in charcoal grey, a boy of fifteen in faded indigo, a stout man of fifty in dark olive green, a middle-aged woman in dark grey with a faded indigo head cloth and a broad-backed man of about forty in an undyed hemp short jacket and a cloth head wrap, all six seen only from behind, the backs of their heads and their shoulders toward the camera from the first frame; beyond them, soft, the grey plank barn and its dark doorway; at the lower right edge of the frame the empty path of trampled earth; their hands hold only what is described here; exactly six people, all seen only from behind. Only the six people of the village seen from behind are in the frame; no second copy of anyone appears. The picture fixes the place and its light only, never the mood. In the middle of the shot all six turn their heads at the same moment toward the path at the lower right edge of the frame, as if someone is coming along it, their shoulders following a little after their heads, and they stay turned toward the right edge of the frame to the last frame, every one of them still turned away from the camera, only the backs of their heads and at most the edge of a cheek in view; all six stay silent, and the low warm morning sunlight stays unchanged. The camera holds a static shot. One continuous shot. The picture is clean, with no subtitles, captions or text anywhere on screen; the fresh still air of early morning, a clean natural film image. Natural, realistic human motion of real actors, their heads and shoulders turning together.
